  PROBLEM: The `verify_inputs` step posts the pending status using only `github.token` and fails the job if the post is refused, without trying the `GH_PAT` fallback added to the later `verify_publish` step.
  WHY: A consumer wrapper predating `statuses: write` fails before reaching `verify_publish`, so the bootstrap fix does not let the update PR proceed to auto-merge; severity was BLOCKER in one review and MAJOR in the others, so the highest severity is used.

  WHY: When the job token lacks status permission, the failure-status post cannot report the job failure.

  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The instruction that setting either variable to `false` returns to an unverified direct push misstates the independent behavior of the two flags.
  WHY: An unverified direct push requires both flags to be `false`; setting either one alone produces a different delivery or verification mode.
- agents.md:2936 | severity=low | confidence=5

  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The module docstring describes the old default-off behavior, contradicting the default-on behavior asserted by the tests.
  WHY: The docstring misleads maintainers about the contract for unset and empty flag values.
